# Simplr

This website is a headless WordPress front end built with Vite and React.

## Main pages
- http://localhost:5173/work
- http://localhost:5173/about
- http://localhost:5173/services
- http://localhost:5173/thinking
- http://localhost:5173/contact
- http://localhost:5173/est-2014

## Dynamic content
- Work singles are resolved from /work/:slug
- Thinking singles are resolved from /thinking/:topic/:slug

## Content model guidance
- Work should map to a custom post type exposed through WPGraphQL.
- Thinking should map to posts or another exposed content type.
- About, Services, Contact, and Est. 2014 should be WordPress pages with matching URIs.

## Technical notes
- Canonical URLs and Open Graph tags are set per route.
- JSON-LD is emitted for Organization, WebSite, CollectionPage, WebPage, Article, Service ItemList, and ContactPage where relevant.
- sitemap.xml and robots.txt are generated at build time.
